# Project contribution outline

Keep drafts outside content/. Add the project to Work only when there is meaningful evidence to inspect.

- Title and slug:
- Short summary:
- Your role and collaborators:
- Dates:
- Visibility: draft / published
- Project lifecycle: in progress / released / archived
- Technologies actually used:
- Permitted preview with alt text and caption:
- Public product, demo, or source links:

## The problem

Who needed what? What constraint mattered?

## My contribution

What did you personally implement, change, or support? Separate product ownership and team work.

## A decision

Explain a real choice, an alternative, and the trade-off. Label proposed work as proposed.

## Verification and outcome

Describe an actual check or approved evidence. Use numbers only when sourced. Label synthetic examples.

## Reflection

What did you learn? What would you improve?
